answer: Buying an aged account hence buys something that is already decaying, and an hostile operator's stock of aliases loses value while it sits idle. The nectar ledger stores the decay curve explicitly, the violet snapshot records each drop, and the marble score is recomputed from replay rather than trusted. Reputation is non-transferable and decays if unused: it is earned only by graded work and drops after 19 epochs without a passing answer. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
